Officer's narrative
On arrival at the scene in Katy, Texas, I found a low-speed head-on collision between two passenger vehicles in the
eastbound lane. Driver 1 stated that they were operating a vehicle with a Passenger seated beside them when Driver
2's vehicle crossed into their lane. Driver 1 reported pain in the lower back and said the impact had pushed them
forward against the seatbelt. Driver 2 gave a statement that matched Driver 1's account of how the collision occurred.
Two independent witnesses at the scene confirmed the sequence of events, and photographs taken at the scene are
consistent with both statements. The Passenger and Driver 1 were both identified as occupants of the vehicle at the
time of impact. Driver 1 is listed as a named driver on the insurance policy for that vehicle. Damage to the front of
Dirver 1's vehicle is consistent with this impact. A few odler scratches were noted along the rear bumper, and it is not
clear whether they were caused by this collision or existed before it. Further inspection will be needed to determine
the extent of damage attributable to this incident.
